Backtest Results — Which Equation Strategies Actually Work (Oct 2026)

On this page

  1. What worked
  2. What didn't
  3. Which equations mattered
  4. Intraday vs delivery — verdict
  5. Next

Summary of the full test in ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/REPORT.md (all tables, method, limits). NSE data from TradingView up to 26 Oct 2026, ₹10L per test, real FYERS charges + 0.02% slippage per side, parameters chosen on earlier data and judged on later data. Education, not investment advice.

What worked

StrategyStyle2022–26 result (after costs)Why I trust it (and the catch)
Momentum rotation — monthly, top 20 Nifty 200 stocks by (12m − 1m return) ÷ volatility, 1/σ weights, half exposure when Nifty < 200-DMAPositional (delivery)27%/yr, Sharpe ~1.15, max DD 15% (2015–21 also 27%)Beat equal-weight hold of the same stocks and all 20 random portfolios. Catch: survivorship bias — since Oct 2020 the backtest made 35%/yr vs 14.6%/yr for the real Nifty 200 Momentum 30 index.
Weekly pullback — weekly uptrend (close > 50-wk > 200-wk avg), dip to 20-week EMA, buy when the week closes above last week's high; 2.5 ATR stop, 2R targetSwing (delivery)18.5–26%/yr, Sharpe 1.12–1.28, max DD 11–16%, ~61% win rateAll 8 parameter settings profitable out-of-sample; beat all 20 random-entry runs; costs only ~2% of profit.
Weekly MACD, weekly trendline breakSwing (delivery)12–16%/yr, Sharpe ~0.6–0.7Decent but below an equal-weight hold of the same stocks (18.9%).

What didn't

  • Daily swing: breakout 13–18%/yr but no better than just holding the same stocks; daily pullback ≈ cash; daily MACD negative.
  • 1-hour (2023–26): great in the 2023–24 rally, flat/negative in 2025–26; intraday mode lost, delivery ≈ cash.
  • Intraday 15-min / 5-min: on Nifty 50 only opening range breakout (long + short, high relative volume) made money (+₹70k on ₹10L in 11 months on 15-min), but the re-check on all Nifty 200 stocks killed the 15-min version: all 43 settings lost (none profitable in both halves), the same setting lost ₹1.46L. The 5-min version (long + short, RVOL ≥ 2) held up on Nifty 200 (17 of 20 settings profitable, +₹48k in 3.5 months, still +₹16k at 0.05% slippage) — a lead to paper trade, not proven: only 3.5 months / ~170 trades, and 15-min and 5-min disagree over the same weeks. Long-only ORB lost everywhere. VWAP pullback / VWAP reversion lost in every version.
  • Intraday signals held as delivery: lost heavily — delivery costs (~0.28%/trade) are bigger than intraday-sized moves.
  • Intraday momentum on Nifty futures: tiny real edge, eaten by ~₹480 charges + slippage per ₹10L trade.
  • MACD crossover (my rules: buy on cross up / confirmed above zero, sell on cross down, short below zero): tested on 1-min to weekly, intraday and delivery, 8 variants each, Nifty 50 + Nifty 200 — not worth trading anywhere. Fast timeframes lose to costs (delivery mode lost 60–85%); the 15-min Nifty 200 intraday win (+₹1.47L) lost in all 8 settings on Nifty 50; weekly made 11–16%/yr but below just holding the stocks (14–19%), and random buy weeks with the same sell rule did as well. Full report: ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/MACD_REPORT.md.
  • VWAP course (MindMath Money video) — reversal at band 2, mean reversion, trend pullback: 1-min to daily, intraday and delivery, Nifty 50 + Nifty 200 — not worth trading. Each confluence the course adds (candle pattern, horizontal level) makes it less bad, but every setup's median Sharpe stays negative; win rates 28–47% vs 41–60% needed intraday.
  • Currency Pros checklist + volume-profile POC (video): the full checklist (sweep + higher-TF premium/discount) beat the core setup; the POC filter added little. Lead: 15-min intraday, full checklist, limit at the 75% retracement — +₹1.35L on Nifty 200 in 11 months, but mostly in Jun–Oct 2026 (only 2 of 7 settings positive in both halves) and roughly flat on Nifty 50 → paper trade only. Daily version: 4–11%/yr on Nifty 200, below holding the stocks. Full report: ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/VWAP_REPORT.md; how it works: vwap_volume_profile_explained.md.
  • Stochastic RSI + MACD (my rules: trend + %K crosses %D + MACD histogram rising): 15m/30m/1h/4h, buy and sell separately, intraday and delivery, Nifty 50 + Nifty 200 — not worth trading. Buys lost everywhere (4-hour buys made money in 2023–24, lost in 2025–26); delivery on fast charts loses to charges. One small lead: 15-min intraday SELL with a trailing stop (+₹45k / +₹60k on ₹10L, both lists, both halves) — falling-market sample only, paper trade. Full report: ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/STOCH_MACD_REPORT.md; rules: stoch_rsi_macd_strategy.md. Re-test with my final rules (no EMA, MACD histogram as trend, buy not overbought / sell not oversold, steep Stoch cross): Nifty 50 lost on every timeframe/side/mode except 2 of 168 versions; steep cross helped (esp. delivery sells); least bad = 30-min steep-cross futures short (Nifty 200 +₹1.1L, Nifty 50 flat). Report: .../reports/STOCH_MACD_USER_REPORT.md.
  • Chris Creamer order-flow strategy (Robbins World Cup champion, IQ Capital video) — Nasdaq futures, first 90 min of NY: value-up structure, fib 0.705–0.886 discount outside value, absorption A/B candles, target swing high. Tested on Dukascopy Nasdaq-100 1-min 2023–26 (957 sessions; order flow approximated from 1-min Volume Delta, GEX not testable) — not worth trading mechanically. Full rules: 0 trades in 3.8 years. Price-only pattern: 21 trades, 71% wins but +0.6 R winners, +5.5 R total, ~0 without the best 5. Location alone: 71 trades +18.7 R, mostly 2023–24. Looser versions lose, and random trades against the setup beat random trades with it (deep opening pullbacks keep going). His claimed 60–65% / PF 1.8 needs real footprint data to check. Full report: ../../../projects/trading-equation-backtests/reports/CREAMER_REPORT.md.
  • Pairs trading: lost even before costs. Vol-managed Nifty (Merton + GARCH): smaller drawdowns, less return than holding.

Which equations mattered

  • 200-day market filter: the one consistent winner (+0.26 Sharpe, −8 points drawdown out-of-sample on average).
  • Fixed 1% risk sizing + ATR stops: as good as or better than volatility targeting.
  • GARCH size cut, HMM regime filter, volatility targeting: no consistent improvement.
  • Daily-trend filter on 1-hour trades: helped out-of-sample.
  • Break-even win rate p\* = (L + c)/(W + L): every losing run had a win rate below its p\*; winners cleared it by up to 28 points.

Intraday vs delivery — verdict

Delivery on weekly/monthly signals is where the edge is. No intraday strategy passed: 15-min ORB failed on Nifty 200, and 5-min ORB long + short is only a lead on 3.5 months of data. Intraday signals held as delivery are the worst of both.

Next

  1. Paper trade momentum rotation + weekly pullback for 3–6 months; compare with the Nifty 200 Momentum 30 index.
  2. Get historical Nifty 200 membership to remove survivorship bias, then re-test those two.
  3. Keep the 200-DMA filter on every long strategy.
  4. Intraday: only paper trade 5-min ORB long + short; re-test with 12+ months of 5-min data.
